ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  GALLANTT ISPAT LIMITED has announced the appointment of Mr. Amit Jalan as its new Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), effective July 27, 2026. This is a material internal promotion, as Mr. Jalan brings over 25 years of extensive finance experience and has been with the company since its incorporation, most recently as Chief Accounts Officer, ensuring strong continuity and deep institutional knowledge in financial leadership. The appointment appears standard and well-supported, with no immediate red flags identified.
